'''Peter Jurcovic''' (DeckTech handle '''marvin''')<ref name="dt-26448">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/26448 Hold Me Thrill Me Kiss Me Kill Me], DeckTech (Peter "marvin" Jurcovic, 2 December 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/26448/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/26448/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009013131/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/26448/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Dark]] [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|My Lord, Is That Legal?]] list on DeckTech (''Hold Me Thrill Me Kiss Me Kill Me''). He posted a [[Dark]] [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time]] list on DeckTech (''There Are Those Droidekas'').<ref name="dt-23346">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23346 There Are Those Droidekas], DeckTech (Peter "marvin" Jurcovic, 14 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23346/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23346/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009173622/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23346/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
